env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^names-main \[Port Host hidden\]$'
stdout '^names-cfg \[Port\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/wire/wire.go
grep '^func Names_logosct' out/main.go
grep -count=2 '^func .*_logosct[0-9][(]' out/main.go
! grep 'Names_logosct[0-9][[]' out/main.go
! grep 'Names_logosct' out/wire/wire.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/xcopyct

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/xcopyct/wire"
)

type Service struct {
	Port   int
	Host   string
	hidden int
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("names-main", wire.Names[Service]())
	fmt.Println("names-cfg", wire.Names[wire.Config]())
}

-- m/wire/wire.lgo --
package wire

import "comptime"

type Config struct {
	Port   int
	secret int
}

func Names[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}
